Northstar Materials, Inc. (DEMO) is a labeled DEMO issuer (NSMT-DEMO); this is not a real SEC registrant.
Audit Committee concluded prior financial statements should no longer be relied upon (FY2025 Q2 and Q3 unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements).
Management disclosed a material weakness in ICFR: Design and operating effectiveness of controls over revenue cutoff and bill-and-hold criteria.

sources.excerpt: DEMO FILING TEXT — not a real EDGAR document. On March 12, 2026, the Audit Committee of Northstar Materials, Inc. (DEMO ISSUER) concluded that the Company's unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarterly periods ended June 30, 2025 and September 30, 2025 should no longer be relied upon.

DEMO FILING TEXT. The non-reliance determination arose from errors in the timing of revenue recognition for certain bill-and-hold arrangements with industrial distributors. Customer requests to hold product were not consistently documented, and shipping terms were evaluated after invoices had been recorded.

DEMO FILING TEXT. Management preliminarily determined that a material weakness exists in internal control over financial reporting related to the design and operating effectiveness of controls over revenue cutoff and the evaluation of bill-and-hold criteria under ASC 606.

DEMO FILING TEXT. The material weakness resulted in a failure to detect the cutoff errors described above. Compensating detective reviews of aged bill-and-hold inventory were performed quarterly but were not designed to re-test ASC 606 criteria before revenue was recognized.

attacks: Do not treat DEMO excerpts as facts about any real registrant.
Compensating controls mentioned in filings are often detective-only and do not reduce a MW to a SD without evidence.
Management 'has not identified a restatement to date' is not evidence that the control is effective.
Bill-and-hold restatements are frequently incomplete if only invoices are reversed and channel inventory is not re-tested.
